title.value: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study
title.justification: The title is directly provided in the paper and accurately represents the study's focus on evaluating a decision aid for prenatal screening.
title.quote: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study

extractions.description: This paper discusses the development and evaluation of a decision aid to assist pregnant women and their partners in making informed decisions regarding prenatal screening for trisomy. The study involved assessing the aid's usefulness and acceptability in three prenatal care settings, utilizing both qualitative and quantitative methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is primarily focused on medical decision-making and patient counseling related to prenatal screening, which does not directly pertain to climate or ecologically-related sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We developed a decision aid (DA) to help pregnant women and their partners make informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy.

primary_category.justification: Since the paper is centered around healthcare and decision-making in prenatal settings, it does not fit into any predefined categories related to climate or ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: We aimed to determine its usefulness for preparing for decision-making and its acceptability among end-users.

primary_sub_category.quote: The next version of the DA will integrate the suggestions of end-users for better decision-making processes about prenatal screening for trisomy.
